title: Velantrim Provenance Metadata (target envelope)
description: Target provenance metadata envelope for canonical-graph operations. This is a forward-looking contract: the current runtime represents provenance through the trace / receipt / audit structures (see trace.schema.json and core/audit.py), and does not yet emit this envelope (no schema_version / source_ref / trace_id fields are produced today). The enum blocks below mirror the canonical vocabulary in core/memory.py and fact.schema.json.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the metadata schema used (e.g. '1.0.0')

source_ref.description: Target field: identifies the originating artifact, session or document. Today the runtime stores the origin in the fact's 'source' field and evidence spans ('source_uri').

trace_id.description: Target field: would link this record back to the answer trace/receipt that created it. Today receipts are identified by their sealed content digest, not a separate id.

guardian_verified.description: Reserved field. Not currently emitted or consumed by the Crystal runtime. Must default to false unless an explicit future review workflow sets it.
